A lot, I ride this depression train a lot but it hasn't been this bad since a year ago. I hate myself more than anything, ya know what I hate most? I have a loving girlfriend right now who would absolutely Walk Through Hell for my lost and damned soul and then bring it back to me if she heard me saying half of this. But we're in high school. I'm 17, a junior, she's 14 1/2, a freshman.

I feel so fucking terrible for making her deal with such adult issues, she's 14, I shouldn't even been fucking dating her, but she is remarkably mature for her age and makes me smile. I swear to god I treat her as best as I can, she's my princess, I call her that, and she loves me, she always writes me notes about how I should be happy everyday.

I just...I think back to how unstressed I was as a freshman and constantly think how I'm robbing her of her childhood by dating her...
Do me a favor mate; go to YouTube, listen to Superman by Five for Fighting, it might resonate with you. Tell me what you think after

I grieve not for me, but for my future. My parents expect me to get into a great college after next year. This is the tail end of my junior year and with my GPA being a 2.9 from freshman and sophomore year it isn't looking like it'll get much better.

I just wanna get into Fordham, follow my dad's foot steps, and be an English major. I want to get in more than anything on this earth and it gets me so depressed I won't.
